## Load dataset

```{webr-r}
library(palmerpenguins)
head(penguins)
```


## Visualise data

```{webr-r}
plot(body_mass_g ~ species, data = penguins)
```


## Fit model

Fit a linear model to analyse e.g. body mass differences across sites, species, or sex. 

```{webr-r}
model <- lm()
summary(model)
```


## Visualise model

```{webr-r}
library(visreg)
visreg(model)
```


## Check model

```{webr-r}
library(easystats)
check_model(model)
```
